licensing.windows_server: visible vCPU quantity; f1-micro and g1-small have a separate whole-instance rate
licensing.sql_server: edition-specific license quantity max(visible vCPU, 4), in addition to Windows and compute
licensing.spot_discount: does not discount premium image licenses
licensing.unknown_license: exclude or explicitly unpriced; never infer free from missing metadata

disk.unit: GiB; monthly rate is normalized over configured estimation hours, not multiplied by displayQuantity
disk.performance: MIN(disk baseline + per-GiB contribution, exact machine/disk-type cap)
disk.api_shape: DiskType does not expose numeric performance caps; central source-attested facts must not masquerade as API fields
disk.local_ssd: price actual bundled capacity separately unless an exact whole-machine meter includes it; Spot uses matching Spot local-SSD rates

cases.name: fixed_gpu_bundle
cases.forbidden: whole-machine bundle plus a duplicate GPU charge

qualification_limit: Source-derived local contract, synthetic values; no live pricing or performance qualification.

catalog_usage_types.rule: unknown/non-Spot is not automatically OnDemand; commitment products never enter ordinary market quotes
